description: Video generation project that converts prompts to videos with intelligent script creation and character-based voice synthesis.
features: Start playing video as soon as the first node is ready
Buffer content when video node or audio aren't available
Generate improved scripts following a story arc structure
Use different character voices matching each character instead of a single narrator voice
design_notes: Video titled Vision Magnet with red cursive title font, black description text, colorful background with objects (clock, chair, table). Chat window interface below video player.
